name: Gratitude journal
summary: Keep a gratitude journal with 30 or 90 days of prompts at the time of day you choose.

plan_blueprint.calendar: A daily prompt at the chosen time and a monthly look-back.

approach_variants.habit: Journal right after an existing habit (bedtime, first coffee); streak of entries.
approach_variants.willpower: Challenge: five gratitudes a day for a week, with a countdown to day 30 or 90.
approach_variants.time: Journaling as a fixed calendar block; weekly review.
approach_variants.reward: Look-back at each milestone with an owner-chosen treat.
approach_variants.resource: First day sets up a notebook or note app and a spot to write.

guardrails: Entries are private by default and never shared without your choice.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed days aren't counted against you; the next prompt continues where you left off.
